title: Look definition (Custom Object value, container "look", key "look-<lookKey>")

setPrice.description: Cent amount per price cell: `EUR/DE` (currency and country) or `EUR` for a price without a country. Each is below the live sum of the pieces in that cell; a cell without an entry has no discount.

savingPercent.description: Cells whose discount is a percentage (a relative Cart Discount), at most one decimal. Every other cell in `setPrice` has an absolute discount. For a percentage cell `setPrice` holds the price derived when saving (informational); readers derive it live from the sum.

endedAt.description: Set when the look is switched off, removed when switched on.
